title: styphelia lanceolata
intro: Styphelia lanceolata, commonly known as Mountain Pepper, is a plant species native to Tasmania. It has been used for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Pepper include analgesic and antiseptic effects, which may help alleviate pain and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Styphelia lanceolata include compounds such as 4-hydroxybenzyl isothiocyanate, which is responsible for its medicinal properties.
